annotations.title: Attacker: Why an Address Was Flagged

description: One address across the caller's apps: the verdict and risk score with the signals behind them (from the latest verification), reputation, whether it is blocked (where and until when) or never blocked, first and last seen, what it tried, the detections it triggered in 30 days with their outcomes, its block history, a timeline of its events, its traffic over the last 3 days against the apps' normal (error rate, share of traffic, distinct paths, scanner-path requests, attack payloads answered 2xx), and suggested questions for the forensics chat.
name: securenow_attacker
